      - intros k pre1 Ts B u1 u2 pre2 t f1 f2 Hf IH Hfr1 Hfr2 u3 pre3 f3 Mk ms1 ms2 c gs1 t0 gs2 ws1 ws2 k0 ys1 ys2 HM Hρ1 Hρ2 HTs Hn Hc Hw Hs Hk Hy Hz.
        subst pre1 pre2 Ts; inversion Hz; subst.
        match goal with Hx : arg_kind _ _ f3 = ak_relevant |- _ => rename Hx into Hfr3 end.
        match goal with Hz0 : forall c c', doms_rel _ _ _ _ c c' -> _ |- _ => rename Hz0 into Hz' end.
        pose proof (nparams_rel_refl_l _ _ HM _ _ Hn) as Hnn.
        destruct (shape_pi_step _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HM Hnn Hc Hw Hs Hy) as (HB & Hs' & Hk' & HP & Hstep).
        constructor; [| exact Hfr1 | exact Hfr3 ]; intros a a3 Haa.
        assert (H33 : doms_rel k (ms1 ++ ws1 ++ ys1) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1 ++ List.firstn k0 (shape_doms_tele t0)) B a3 a3)
          by (etransitivity; [ symmetry; exact Haa | exact Haa ]).
        pose proof (proj1 (HdI _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HM Hn Hc eq_refl Hw HB Hy _ _) H33) as H33'.
        specialize (Hz' _ _ H33').
        eapply (IH a a3 Haa _ _ _ _ Mk ms1 ms2 c gs1 t0 gs2 ws1 ws2 (S k0) (ys1 ++ a :: nil) (ys2 ++ a3 :: nil) HM);
          [ rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; reflexivity | rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; reflexivity
          | apply prefix_tele_snoc_dom; exact HB
          | exact Hn | exact Hc | exact Hw | exact Hs' | exact Hk' | apply Hstep; exact Haa | exact Hz' ].
      - intros f1 a1 r1 f2 a2 r2 k u1 u2 pre1 pre2 Ts t E1 E2 Hsh IH u3 pre3 f3 a3 Mk ms1 ms2 c gs1 t0 gs2 ws1 ws2 kk ys1 ys2
          HM Hρ1 Hρ2 HTs Hn Hc Hw Hs Hk Hy Hz.
        inversion Hz; subst.
        match goal with
        | E : eval_app _ _ f2 a2 ?R, E' : eval_app _ _ f2 a2 ?R' |- _ =>
            assert_fails (unify R R'); pose proof (functional_eval_app _ _ _ _ E E') as <-
        end.
        econstructor; [ exact E1 | eassumption |].
        eapply IH; [ exact HM | reflexivity | reflexivity | reflexivity | exact Hn | exact Hc | exact Hw | reflexivity | exact Hk | exact Hy | eassumption ].
    Qed.

Moving the indices: the top-level telescope facts only.
    Lemma ind_rel_idx : forall okr k Mk u u' ns ns' x y ns1 ns1', ind_member D k = Some Mk ->
        ind_rel p D okr nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel k u u' ns ns' x y ->
        tele_rel (nparams_rel k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) ns ns1 -> tele_rel (nparams_rel k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) ns' ns1' ->
        ind_rel p D okr nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel k u u' ns1 ns1' x y.
    Proof.
      intros * HM H H1 H1'.
      destruct H as [k0 Mk0 hd k' ns0 ns0' c gs bs bs' vs vs' u0 u0' HM0 Hrv Hr Hn Hc Hb Hb' Hs Hs' Ha Hia
                    | k0 Mk0 hd k' ns0 ns0' as1 as2 m m' u0 u0' HM0 Hrv Hr Hn L1 L2 Hs Hs' Hm
                    | ];
        [ rewrite HM in HM0; injection HM0 as <- .. |
          rewrite (tele_rel_nil_l _ _ _ H1), (tele_rel_nil_l _ _ _ H1'); econstructor; eassumption ].
      - eapply ind_rel_con with (gs := gs); try eassumption;
          [ exact (nparams_rel_trans _ _ HM _ _ _ (nparams_rel_sym _ _ HM _ _ H1) (nparams_rel_trans _ _ HM _ _ _ Hn H1'))
          | exact (nparams_rel_trans _ _ HM _ _ _ (nparams_rel_sym _ _ HM _ _ H1) Hs)
          | exact (nparams_rel_trans _ _ HM _ _ _ (nparams_rel_sym _ _ HM _ _ H1') Hs') ].
      - eapply ind_rel_neut; try eassumption;
          [ exact (nparams_rel_trans _ _ HM _ _ _ (nparams_rel_sym _ _ HM _ _ H1) (nparams_rel_trans _ _ HM _ _ _ Hn H1'))
          | exact (nparams_rel_trans _ _ HM _ _ _ (nparams_rel_sym _ _ HM _ _ H1) Hs)
          | exact (nparams_rel_trans _ _ HM _ _ _ (nparams_rel_sym _ _ HM _ _ H1') Hs') ].
    Qed.

The two indices of related elements are related.
    Lemma ind_rel_ns : forall okr k Mk u u' ns ns' x y, ind_member D k = Some Mk ->
        ind_rel p D okr nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel k u u' ns ns' x y ->
        tele_rel (nparams_rel k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) ns ns'.
    Proof.
      intros * HM H; destruct H;
        match goal with H0 : ind_member D _ = Some _ |- _ => rewrite HM in H0; injection H0 as <- end;
        [ assumption | assumption |].
      match goal with Hn : im_nparams _ = nil |- _ => rewrite Hn; split; reflexivity + exact I end.
    Qed.

The admissibility the swapped type needs: of ups and of ups' beside ups'.
    Lemma adm_flip : forall ups', adm_uparams D ups nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel ups' -> adm_uparams D ups nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel ups -> adm_uparams D ups' nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel ups.
    Proof. intros * H' H; exact (adm_base _ _ H' H). Qed.

    Lemma adm_diag_r : forall ups', adm_uparams D ups nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel ups' -> adm_uparams D ups' nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel ups'.
    Proof. intros * H'; exact (adm_base _ _ H' H'). Qed.

The bases admissible beside ups are those admissible beside a base admissible beside it.
    Lemma adm_iff : forall ups', adm_uparams D ups nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel ups' ->
        forall u, adm_uparams D ups nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel u <-> adm_uparams D ups' nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel u.
    Proof. intros * H' u; split; [ exact (adm_base _ _ H') | exact (adm_compose _ _ H') ]. Qed.

Admissibility at the Fresh Variables, at Another Base

A base ups' admissible beside ups at every prefix makes the fresh variables at ups' related to those at ups: ups' is admissible beside ups at the fresh variables (adm_fresh_of_uparams).

    Section FreshBase.
      Variable (ups' : list domain).
      Hypothesis (Hcl : adm_uparams D ups nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel ups').

The fresh variables of the non-uniform parameters at ups and at ups' are related.
      Lemma fresh_tele_pair : forall m Mm T0 T k pre pre0 s ws ws0, ind_member D m = Some Mm ->
          List.rev (im_nparams Mm) = T0 ++ T -> List.length T0 = k ->
          tele_prefix_rel (nparams_rel m) k pre pre0 ->
          Ftele T in gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ components_env D ups T0 pre ⍮ s ↘ ws ->
          Ftele T in gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ components_env D ups' T0 pre0 ⍮ s ↘ ws0 ->
          tele_prefix_rel (nparams_rel m) (k + List.length T) (pre ++ ws) (pre0 ++ ws0).
      Proof.
        intros m Mm T0 T; revert T0; induction T as [| e T IH]; intros T0 k pre pre0 s ws ws0 HM HT Hk Hp F F0; subst k.
        - inversion F; inversion F0; subst; rewrite !List.app_nil_r, Nat.add_0_r; exact Hp.
        - inversion F as [| A ρ0 a T' s0 vs κ Ea F' ]; subst; inversion F0 as [| A0 ρ1 a0 T'' s1 vs0 κ0 Ea0 F0' ]; subst.
          assert (HA : List.nth_error (List.rev (im_nparams Mm)) (List.length T0) = Some (ce_ass κ A))
            by (rewrite HT, List.nth_error_app2, Nat.sub_diag by lia; reflexivity).
          destruct (adm_nparam_types _ _ _ _ _ _ Hcl m Mm (List.length T0) κ A pre pre0 HM HA Hp) as [b b0 Eb Eb0 _ _ Vb].
          pose proof (Vb s) as Rb.
          pose proof (proj1 (tele_prefix_rel_iff _ _ _ _) Hp) as (Hl & Hl' & _).
          rewrite HT in Eb, Eb0; rewrite (components_env_prefix _ ups T0) in Eb by lia.
          rewrite (components_env_prefix _ ups' T0) in Eb0 by lia.
          pose proof (functional_eval_exp _ _ _ _ Eb Ea) as ->; pose proof (functional_eval_exp _ _ _ _ Eb0 Ea0) as ->.
          rewrite <- (components_env_snoc _ _ _ _ κ) in F' by lia.
          rewrite <- (components_env_snoc _ _ _ _ κ) in F0' by lia.
          pose proof (IH (T0 ++ ce_ass κ A :: nil) (S (List.length T0)) (pre ++ ⇑! a s :: nil) (pre0 ++ ⇑! a0 s :: nil) (S s) vs vs0 HM
                        ltac:(rewrite HT, <- List.app_assoc; reflexivity) ltac:(rewrite List.length_app; cbn; lia)
                        (tele_prefix_rel_snoc _ _ _ _ _ _ Hp Rb) F' F0') as H.
          rewrite <- !List.app_assoc in H; cbn in H.
          cbn [List.length]; rewrite <- plus_n_Sm; exact H.
      Qed.

Admissibility at every related prefix gives it at the fresh variables: those of the non-uniform parameters, and after them those of each constructor's arguments, are related prefixes.
      Lemma fresh_tele_rel_of_adm : forall m Mm T0 T k pre pre0 s, ind_member D m = Some Mm ->
          List.rev (im_nparams Mm) = T0 ++ T -> List.length T0 = k ->
          tele_prefix_rel (nparams_rel m) k pre pre0 ->
          fresh_tele_rel (nparams_rel m) k pre pre0 (components_env D ups T0 pre) (components_env D ups' T0 pre0) s T.
      Proof.
        intros m Mm T0 T; revert T0; induction T as [| e T IH]; intros T0 k pre pre0 s HM HT Hk Hp; [ constructor |].
        assert (Hkl : k < List.length (List.rev (im_nparams Mm))) by (rewrite HT, List.length_app; cbn; lia).
        destruct (nparams_lt_ass D m Mm k Hass HM Hkl) as (κ & A & HA).
        rewrite HT, List.nth_error_app2, <- Hk, Nat.sub_diag in HA by lia; cbn in HA; injection HA as ->.
        subst k.
        assert (HA' : List.nth_error (List.rev (im_nparams Mm)) (List.length T0) = Some (ce_ass κ A))
          by (rewrite HT, List.nth_error_app2, Nat.sub_diag by lia; reflexivity).
        pose proof (proj1 (tele_prefix_rel_iff _ _ _ _) Hp) as (Hl & Hl' & _).
        destruct (adm_nparam_types _ _ _ _ _ _ Hcl m Mm (List.length T0) κ A pre pre0 HM HA' Hp) as [a a0 Ea Ea0 _ _ Va].
        pose proof (Va s) as Ra.
        rewrite HT in Ea, Ea0; rewrite (components_env_prefix _ ups T0) in Ea by lia.
        rewrite (components_env_prefix _ ups' T0) in Ea0 by lia.
        econstructor; [ exact Ea | exact Ea0 | exact Ra |].
        rewrite <- (components_env_snoc _ ups _ _ κ) by lia; rewrite <- (components_env_snoc _ ups' _ _ κ) by lia.
        apply (IH (T0 ++ ce_ass κ A :: nil)); [ exact HM | rewrite HT, <- List.app_assoc; reflexivity
                                            | rewrite List.length_app; cbn; lia |].
        apply tele_prefix_rel_snoc; [ exact Hp | exact Ra ].
      Qed.

      Lemma fresh_cargs_rel_of_adm : forall m Mm c gsf gs1 gs ns ns' k ws ws' s, ind_member D m = Some Mm ->
          ind_con Mm c = Some gsf -> gsf = gs1 ++ gs -> List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1) = k ->
          tele_rel (nparams_rel m) (List.rev (im_nparams Mm)) ns ns' ->
          tele_prefix_rel (args_rel m ns c) k ws ws' ->
          fresh_cargs_rel D nparams_rel (args_rel m ns c) (doms_rel m) (List.rev (im_nparams Mm)) ns ns' k
            (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) ws ws'
            (components_env D ups (List.rev (im_nparams Mm) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) (ns ++ ws))
            (components_env D ups' (List.rev (im_nparams Mm) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) (ns' ++ ws')) s gs.
      Proof.
        intros m Mm c gsf gs1 gs; revert gs1; induction gs as [| [r A | t] gs IH];
          intros gs1 ns ns' k ws ws' s HM Hc Heq Hk Hn Hp; [ constructor | |].
        all: pose proof (proj1 (tele_rel_iff _ _ _ _) Hn) as (Hln & Hln' & _).
        all: pose proof (proj1 (tele_prefix_rel_iff _ _ _ _) Hp) as (Hlw & Hlw' & _).
        all: assert (Hlen : List.length (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) = k) by (rewrite length_cargs_nonrec_tele; exact Hk).
        - assert (HA : List.nth_error (cargs_nonrec gsf) k = Some A)
            by (rewrite Heq, cargs_nonrec_app, List.nth_error_app2, Hk, Nat.sub_diag by lia; reflexivity).
          destruct (adm_arg_types _ _ _ _ _ _ Hcl m Mm ns ns' c gsf k A ws ws' HM Hn Hc HA Hp) as [a a' Ea Ea' _ _ Va].
          pose proof (Va s) as Ra.
          rewrite Heq in Ea, Ea'; rewrite cargs_nonrec_tele_app in Ea, Ea'.
          rewrite List.app_assoc in Ea, Ea'.
          rewrite (components_env_prefix _ ups (List.rev (im_nparams Mm) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1)) in Ea
            by (rewrite !List.length_app; lia).
          rewrite (components_env_prefix _ ups' (List.rev (im_nparams Mm) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1)) in Ea'
            by (rewrite !List.length_app; lia).
          econstructor; [ exact Ea | exact Ea' | exact Ra |].
          rewrite <- (components_env_snoc _ ups _ _ r) by (rewrite !List.length_app; lia).
          rewrite <- (components_env_snoc _ ups' _ _ r) by (rewrite !List.length_app; lia).
          rewrite <- !List.app_assoc.
          replace (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1 ++ ce_ass r A :: nil) with (cargs_nonrec_tele (gs1 ++ ca_arg r A :: nil))
            by (rewrite cargs_nonrec_tele_app; reflexivity).
          apply (IH (gs1 ++ ca_arg r A :: nil)); [ exact HM | exact Hc | rewrite Heq, <- List.app_assoc; reflexivity
                                              | rewrite cargs_nonrec_app, List.length_app, Hk; cbn; lia | exact Hn |].
          apply tele_prefix_rel_snoc; [ exact Hp | exact Ra ].
        - subst k.
          assert (Hc' : ind_con Mm c = Some (gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: gs)) by (rewrite <- Heq; exact Hc).
          assert (Henv : forall u xs ys, List.length xs = List.length (List.rev (im_nparams Mm) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) ->
                    env_tele (components_env D u (List.rev (im_nparams Mm) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) xs) (shape_doms_tele t) ys =
                    components_env D u (List.rev (im_nparams Mm) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1 ++ shape_doms_tele t) (xs ++ ys))
            by (intros * Hx; unfold components_env; rewrite List.app_assoc, env_tele_app by exact Hx; reflexivity).
          econstructor.
          + intros ys ys' Hy; rewrite !Henv by (rewrite !List.length_app; lia); rewrite <- !List.app_assoc.
            exact (adm_rec_params _ _ _ _ _ _ Hcl m Mm ns ns' c _ gs1 t gs ws ws' ys ys' HM Hn Hc' eq_refl Hp Hy).
          + intros j B ys ys' HB Hy; rewrite !Henv by (rewrite !List.length_app; lia); rewrite <- !List.app_assoc.
            exact (adm_shape_doms _ _ _ _ _ _ Hcl m Mm ns ns' c _ gs1 t gs ws ws' j B ys ys' HM Hn Hc' eq_refl Hp HB Hy).
          + replace (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) with (cargs_nonrec_tele (gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: nil))
              by (rewrite cargs_nonrec_tele_app; cbn; rewrite List.app_nil_r; reflexivity).
            apply (IH (gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: nil)); [ exact HM | exact Hc | rewrite Heq, <- List.app_assoc; reflexivity
                                                | rewrite cargs_nonrec_app, List.length_app; cbn; lia | exact Hn | exact Hp ].
      Qed.

      Lemma adm_fresh_of_uparams : adm_fresh p D ups nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel ups'.
      Proof.
        constructor.
        - intros m Mm s HM; exact (fresh_tele_rel_of_adm m Mm nil _ 0 nil nil s HM eq_refl eq_refl (tele_prefix_rel_nil _)).
        - intros m Mm c gs s ns ns' HM Hc F F'.
          pose proof (fresh_tele_pair m Mm nil _ 0 nil nil s ns ns' HM eq_refl eq_refl (tele_prefix_rel_nil _) F F') as Hp.
          apply tele_rel_of_pre in Hp; cbn in Hp.
          pose proof (fresh_cargs_rel_of_adm m Mm c gs nil gs ns ns' 0 nil nil (s + im_nn Mm) HM Hc eq_refl eq_refl Hp
                        (tele_prefix_rel_nil _)) as H.
          cbn [cargs_nonrec_tele cargs_nonrec List.map] in H; rewrite !List.app_nil_r in H; exact H.
      Qed.

A recursive index admissible beside ups at a prefix related to itself is admissible beside ups'.
      Lemma admissible_index_at_base : forall m Mm ms c gs1 t0 gs2 ws ys bs, ind_member D m = Some Mm ->
          tele_rel (nparams_rel m) (List.rev (im_nparams Mm)) ms ms -> ind_con Mm c = Some (gs1 ++ ca_rec t0 :: gs2) ->
          tele_prefix_rel (args_rel m ms c) (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) ws ws ->
          tele_rel (shape_doms_rel (doms_rel m) (List.rev (im_nparams Mm)) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) ms ws t0) (ptyp_doms t0) ys ys ->
          admissible_index_at D ups nparams_rel (ptyp_mem t0) (ms ++ ws ++ ys)
            (List.rev (im_nparams Mm) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1 ++ shape_doms_tele t0) (ptyp_ps t0) bs ->
          admissible_index_at D ups' nparams_rel (ptyp_mem t0) (ms ++ ws ++ ys)
            (List.rev (im_nparams Mm) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1 ++ shape_doms_tele t0) (ptyp_ps t0) bs.
      Proof.
        intros * HM Hm Hc Hw Hy [idx E R].
        destruct (adm_rec_params _ _ _ _ _ _ Hcl m Mm ms ms c _ gs1 t0 gs2 ws ws ys ys HM Hm Hc eq_refl Hw Hy) as [b b' F F' R0].
        pose proof (functional_eval_exps' _ _ _ _ E F) as <-.
        exists b'; [ exact F' | exact (nparams_tele_rel_trans _ _ _ _ (nparams_tele_rel_sym _ _ _ R0) R) ].
      Qed.

      Lemma ind_rel_admissible_index_base :
          (forall k u u' ns ns' x y, ind_rel p D (admissible_index_at D ups nparams_rel) nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel k u u' ns ns' x y ->
             ind_rel p D (admissible_index_at D ups' nparams_rel) nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel k u u' ns ns' x y) /\
          (forall k u u' pre pre' Ts gs vs vs',
             con_args_rel p D (admissible_index_at D ups nparams_rel) nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel k u u' pre pre' Ts gs vs vs' ->
             forall Mk ms ms' c gsf gs1 vp vp', ind_member D k = Some Mk ->
               pre = ms ++ nonrec_arg_vals gs1 vp -> pre' = ms' ++ nonrec_arg_vals gs1 vp' ->
               List.length vp = List.length gs1 -> List.length vp' = List.length gs1 ->
               tele_rel (nparams_rel k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) ms ms' -> ind_con Mk c = Some gsf -> gsf = gs1 ++ gs ->
               tele_rel (args_rel k ms c) (cargs_nonrec gsf) (nonrec_arg_vals gsf (vp ++ vs)) (nonrec_arg_vals gsf (vp' ++ vs')) ->
               Ts = List.rev (im_nparams Mk) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1 ->
               con_args_rel p D (admissible_index_at D ups' nparams_rel) nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel k u u' pre pre' Ts gs vs vs') /\
          (forall k u u' pre pre' Ts t v v',
             rec_arg_rel p D (admissible_index_at D ups nparams_rel) nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel k u u' pre pre' Ts t v v' ->
             forall Mk ms ms' c gs1 t0 gs2 ws ws' kk ys ys', ind_member D k = Some Mk ->
               pre = ms ++ ws ++ ys -> pre' = ms' ++ ws' ++ ys' ->
               tele_rel (nparams_rel k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) ms ms' -> ind_con Mk c = Some (gs1 ++ ca_rec t0 :: gs2) ->
               tele_prefix_rel (args_rel k ms c) (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) ws ws' ->
               ptyp_skip kk t0 = t -> kk <= List.length (ptyp_doms t0) ->
               tele_prefix_rel (shape_doms_rel (doms_rel k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) ms ws t0) kk ys ys' ->
               Ts = List.rev (im_nparams Mk) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1 ++ List.firstn kk (shape_doms_tele t0) ->
               rec_arg_rel p D (admissible_index_at D ups' nparams_rel) nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel k u u' pre pre' Ts t v v') /\
          (forall k u u' pre pre' Ts t f a f' a',
             rec_arg_app_rel p D (admissible_index_at D ups nparams_rel) nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel k u u' pre pre' Ts t f a f' a' ->
             forall Mk ms ms' c gs1 t0 gs2 ws ws' kk ys ys', ind_member D k = Some Mk ->
               pre = ms ++ ws ++ ys -> pre' = ms' ++ ws' ++ ys' ->
               tele_rel (nparams_rel k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) ms ms' -> ind_con Mk c = Some (gs1 ++ ca_rec t0 :: gs2) ->
               tele_prefix_rel (args_rel k ms c) (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) ws ws' ->
               ptyp_skip kk t0 = t -> kk <= List.length (ptyp_doms t0) ->
               tele_prefix_rel (shape_doms_rel (doms_rel k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) ms ws t0) kk ys ys' ->
               Ts = List.rev (im_nparams Mk) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1 ++ List.firstn kk (shape_doms_tele t0) ->
               rec_arg_app_rel p D (admissible_index_at D ups' nparams_rel) nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel k u u' pre pre' Ts t f a f' a').
      Proof.
        apply ind_rel_mut_ind_all.
        - intros * HM Hrv Hr Hn Hc Hb Hb' Hs Hs' Ha Hia IH.
          assert (Hm : tele_rel (nparams_rel k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) (List.skipn (im_unu D Mk) bs) (List.skipn (im_unu D Mk) bs'))
            by exact (nparams_rel_trans _ _ HM _ _ _ (nparams_rel_trans _ _ HM _ _ _ (nparams_rel_sym _ _ HM _ _ Hs) Hn) Hs').
          eapply ind_rel_con; try eassumption.
          apply (IH Mk (List.skipn (im_unu D Mk) bs) (List.skipn (im_unu D Mk) bs') c gs nil nil nil HM);
            cbn; rewrite ?List.app_nil_r; try reflexivity; assumption.
        - intros; eapply ind_rel_neut; eassumption.
        - intros * HM Hh Hnp Hcs Hp Hp' Ha Hia IH; rview_case_facts.
          eapply ind_rel_record; try eassumption.
          apply (IH Mk nil nil c gs nil nil nil HM); cbn; try reflexivity; try assumption; rewrite Hnp; reflexivity.
        - intros; constructor.
        - intros * Hia IH Mk ms ms' c gsf gs1 vp vp' HM Hρ Hρ' Hl Hl' Hn Hc Heq Ha HTs.
          constructor.
          apply (IH Mk ms ms' c gsf (gs1 ++ ca_arg r A :: nil) (vp ++ v :: nil) (vp' ++ v' :: nil) HM);
            [ rewrite Hρ, nonrec_arg_vals_snoc_arg, List.app_assoc by assumption; reflexivity
            | rewrite Hρ', nonrec_arg_vals_snoc_arg, List.app_assoc by assumption; reflexivity
            | rewrite !List.length_app; cbn; lia | rewrite !List.length_app; cbn; lia | assumption | assumption
            | rewrite Heq, <- List.app_assoc; reflexivity | rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; exact Ha
            | rewrite HTs, cargs_nonrec_tele_snoc_arg, List.app_assoc; reflexivity ].
        - intros * Hsh IHs Hia IH Mk ms ms' c gsf gs1 vp vp' HM Hρ Hρ' Hl Hl' Hn Hc Heq Ha HTs.
          pose proof (nonrec_prefix _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HM (nparams_rel_refl_l _ _ HM _ _ Hn) Hc Heq Hl Hl' Ha) as Hpre.
          constructor.
          + apply (IHs Mk ms ms' c gs1 t gs (nonrec_arg_vals gs1 vp) (nonrec_arg_vals gs1 vp') 0 nil nil HM);
              [ rewrite List.app_nil_r; exact Hρ | rewrite List.app_nil_r; exact Hρ' | exact Hn | rewrite <- Heq; exact Hc
              | exact Hpre | reflexivity | lia | apply tele_prefix_rel_nil | rewrite HTs; cbn; rewrite List.app_nil_r; reflexivity ].
          + apply (IH Mk ms ms' c gsf (gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: nil) (vp ++ v :: nil) (vp' ++ v' :: nil) HM);
              [ rewrite Hρ, nonrec_arg_vals_snoc_rec by assumption; reflexivity
              | rewrite Hρ', nonrec_arg_vals_snoc_rec by assumption; reflexivity
              | rewrite !List.length_app; cbn; lia | rewrite !List.length_app; cbn; lia | assumption | assumption
              | rewrite Heq, <- List.app_assoc; reflexivity | rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; exact Ha
              | rewrite HTs, cargs_nonrec_tele_snoc_rec; reflexivity ].
        -
The end of a shape: each side's index at its own prefix.
          intros * E E' O O' Hr IHr Mk ms ms' c gs1 t0 gs2 ws ws' kk ys ys' HM Hρ Hρ' Hn Hc Hw Hs Hk Hy HTs.
          destruct (ptyp_skip_self _ _ _ _ Hs) as (Hkd & Hj & HPs).
          rewrite shape_doms_tele_firstn_all in HTs by exact Hkd; subst Ts.
          assert (Hyf : tele_rel (shape_doms_rel (doms_rel k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) ms ws t0) (ptyp_doms t0) ys ys')
            by (destruct Hy as [Hyl Hya]; split; [ lia | exact Hya ]).
          pose proof (nparams_rel_refl_l _ _ HM _ _ Hn) as Hnn.
          pose proof (nparams_rel_refl_r _ _ HM _ _ Hn) as Hnn'.
          assert (HK : List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1) <= List.length (cargs_nonrec (gs1 ++ ca_rec t0 :: gs2)))
            by (rewrite cargs_nonrec_app, List.length_app; lia).
          pose proof (args_rel_pre_refl_l _ _ HM _ _ _ Hnn Hc _ _ _ HK Hw) as Hww.
          pose proof (args_prefix_rel_refl_r _ _ HM _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hn Hc HK Hw) as Hww'.
          assert (Hyy : tele_rel (shape_doms_rel (doms_rel k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) ms ws t0) (ptyp_doms t0) ys ys)
            by (apply tele_rel_of_pre; eapply (doms_rel_refl_l _ _ HM ms c _ gs1 t0 gs2 ws Hnn Hc eq_refl Hww);
                [ lia | apply tele_rel_pre; exact Hyf ]).
          assert (Hyy' : tele_rel (shape_doms_rel (doms_rel k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) ms' ws' t0) (ptyp_doms t0) ys' ys')
            by (apply tele_rel_of_pre; eapply (doms_rel_refl_inst _ _ HM);
                [ exact Hn | exact Hc | reflexivity | exact Hw | lia | apply tele_rel_pre; exact Hyf ]).
          subst pre pre' j Ps.
          econstructor; [ exact E | exact E' | | | exact IHr ].
          + exact (admissible_index_at_base _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HM Hnn Hc Hww Hyy O).
          + exact (admissible_index_at_base _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HM Hnn' Hc Hww' Hyy' O').
        - intros * Hf IH Hfr Hfr' Mk ms ms' c gs1 t0 gs2 ws ws' k0 ys ys' HM Hρ Hρ' Hn Hc Hw Hs Hk Hy HTs.
          pose proof (nparams_rel_refl_l _ _ HM _ _ Hn) as Hnn.
          destruct (shape_pi_step _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HM Hnn Hc Hw Hs Hy) as (HB & Hs' & Hk' & HP & Hstep).
          subst pre pre' Ts.
          constructor; [| exact Hfr | exact Hfr' ]; intros a a' Haa.
          apply (IH a a' Haa Mk ms ms' c gs1 t0 gs2 ws ws' (S k0) (ys ++ a :: nil) (ys' ++ a' :: nil) HM);
            [ rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; reflexivity | rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; reflexivity
            | exact Hn | exact Hc | exact Hw | exact Hs' | exact Hk' | apply Hstep; exact Haa
            | apply prefix_tele_snoc_dom; exact HB ].
        - intros * Ef Ef' Hsh IH; intros.
          econstructor; [ exact Ef | exact Ef' | eapply IH; eassumption ].
      Qed.

The right type's base moved to ups': the right side's shapes are read at ups' instead of at u1, both admissible beside ups; the right indices move by ind_rel_idx.
      Lemma ind_rel_base_r : forall u1, adm_uparams D ups nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel u1 ->
          (forall k u u' ns ns' x y, ind_rel p D (admissible_index_at D ups nparams_rel) nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel k u u' ns ns' x y ->
             u' = u1 -> ind_rel p D (admissible_index_at D ups nparams_rel) nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel k u ups' ns ns' x y) /\
          (forall k u u' pre pre' Ts gs vs vs',
             con_args_rel p D (admissible_index_at D ups nparams_rel) nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel k u u' pre pre' Ts gs vs vs' ->
             forall Mk ms ms' c gsf gs1 vp vp', u' = u1 -> ind_member D k = Some Mk ->
               pre = ms ++ nonrec_arg_vals gs1 vp -> pre' = ms' ++ nonrec_arg_vals gs1 vp' ->
               List.length vp = List.length gs1 -> List.length vp' = List.length gs1 ->
               tele_rel (nparams_rel k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) ms ms' -> ind_con Mk c = Some gsf -> gsf = gs1 ++ gs ->
               tele_rel (args_rel k ms c) (cargs_nonrec gsf) (nonrec_arg_vals gsf (vp ++ vs)) (nonrec_arg_vals gsf (vp' ++ vs')) ->
               Ts = List.rev (im_nparams Mk) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1 ->
               con_args_rel p D (admissible_index_at D ups nparams_rel) nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel k u ups' pre pre' Ts gs vs vs') /\
          (forall k u u' pre pre' Ts t v v',
             rec_arg_rel p D (admissible_index_at D ups nparams_rel) nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel k u u' pre pre' Ts t v v' ->
             forall Mk ms ms' c gs1 t0 gs2 ws ws' kk ys ys', u' = u1 -> ind_member D k = Some Mk ->
               pre = ms ++ ws ++ ys -> pre' = ms' ++ ws' ++ ys' ->
               tele_rel (nparams_rel k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) ms ms' -> ind_con Mk c = Some (gs1 ++ ca_rec t0 :: gs2) ->
               tele_prefix_rel (args_rel k ms c) (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) ws ws' ->
               ptyp_skip kk t0 = t -> kk <= List.length (ptyp_doms t0) ->
               tele_prefix_rel (shape_doms_rel (doms_rel k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) ms ws t0) kk ys ys' ->
               Ts = List.rev (im_nparams Mk) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1 ++ List.firstn kk (shape_doms_tele t0) ->
               rec_arg_rel p D (admissible_index_at D ups nparams_rel) nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel k u ups' pre pre' Ts t v v') /\
          (forall k u u' pre pre' Ts t f a f' a',
             rec_arg_app_rel p D (admissible_index_at D ups nparams_rel) nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel k u u' pre pre' Ts t f a f' a' ->
             forall Mk ms ms' c gs1 t0 gs2 ws ws' kk ys ys', u' = u1 -> ind_member D k = Some Mk ->
               pre = ms ++ ws ++ ys -> pre' = ms' ++ ws' ++ ys' ->
               tele_rel (nparams_rel k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) ms ms' -> ind_con Mk c = Some (gs1 ++ ca_rec t0 :: gs2) ->
               tele_prefix_rel (args_rel k ms c) (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) ws ws' ->
               ptyp_skip kk t0 = t -> kk <= List.length (ptyp_doms t0) ->
               tele_prefix_rel (shape_doms_rel (doms_rel k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) ms ws t0) kk ys ys' ->
               Ts = List.rev (im_nparams Mk) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1 ++ List.firstn kk (shape_doms_tele t0) ->
               rec_arg_app_rel p D (admissible_index_at D ups nparams_rel) nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel k u ups' pre pre' Ts t f a f' a').
      Proof.
        intros u1 Hu1; apply ind_rel_mut_ind_all.
        - intros * HM Hrv Hr Hn Hc Hb Hb' Hs Hs' Ha Hia IH Hu.
          assert (Hm : tele_rel (nparams_rel k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) (List.skipn (im_unu D Mk) bs) (List.skipn (im_unu D Mk) bs'))
            by exact (nparams_rel_trans _ _ HM _ _ _ (nparams_rel_trans _ _ HM _ _ _ (nparams_rel_sym _ _ HM _ _ Hs) Hn) Hs').
          eapply ind_rel_con; try eassumption.
          apply (IH Mk (List.skipn (im_unu D Mk) bs) (List.skipn (im_unu D Mk) bs') c gs nil nil nil Hu HM);
            cbn; rewrite ?List.app_nil_r; try reflexivity; assumption.
        - intros; eapply ind_rel_neut; eassumption.
        - intros * HM Hh Hnp Hcs Hp Hp' Ha Hia IH Hu; rview_case_facts.
          eapply ind_rel_record; try eassumption.
          apply (IH Mk nil nil c gs nil nil nil Hu HM); cbn; try reflexivity; try assumption; rewrite Hnp; reflexivity.
        - intros; constructor.
        - intros * Hia IH Mk ms ms' c gsf gs1 vp vp' Hu HM Hρ Hρ' Hl Hl' Hn Hc Heq Ha HTs.
          constructor.
          apply (IH Mk ms ms' c gsf (gs1 ++ ca_arg r A :: nil) (vp ++ v :: nil) (vp' ++ v' :: nil) Hu HM);
            [ rewrite Hρ, nonrec_arg_vals_snoc_arg, List.app_assoc by assumption; reflexivity
            | rewrite Hρ', nonrec_arg_vals_snoc_arg, List.app_assoc by assumption; reflexivity
            | rewrite !List.length_app; cbn; lia | rewrite !List.length_app; cbn; lia | assumption | assumption
            | rewrite Heq, <- List.app_assoc; reflexivity | rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; exact Ha
            | rewrite HTs, cargs_nonrec_tele_snoc_arg, List.app_assoc; reflexivity ].
        - intros * Hsh IHs Hia IH Mk ms ms' c gsf gs1 vp vp' Hu HM Hρ Hρ' Hl Hl' Hn Hc Heq Ha HTs.
          pose proof (nonrec_prefix _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HM (nparams_rel_refl_l _ _ HM _ _ Hn) Hc Heq Hl Hl' Ha) as Hpre.
          constructor.
          + apply (IHs Mk ms ms' c gs1 t gs (nonrec_arg_vals gs1 vp) (nonrec_arg_vals gs1 vp') 0 nil nil Hu HM);
              [ rewrite List.app_nil_r; exact Hρ | rewrite List.app_nil_r; exact Hρ' | exact Hn | rewrite <- Heq; exact Hc
              | exact Hpre | reflexivity | lia | apply tele_prefix_rel_nil | rewrite HTs; cbn; rewrite List.app_nil_r; reflexivity ].
          + apply (IH Mk ms ms' c gsf (gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: nil) (vp ++ v :: nil) (vp' ++ v' :: nil) Hu HM);
              [ rewrite Hρ, nonrec_arg_vals_snoc_rec by assumption; reflexivity
              | rewrite Hρ', nonrec_arg_vals_snoc_rec by assumption; reflexivity
              | rewrite !List.length_app; cbn; lia | rewrite !List.length_app; cbn; lia | assumption | assumption
              | rewrite Heq, <- List.app_assoc; reflexivity | rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; exact Ha
              | rewrite HTs, cargs_nonrec_tele_snoc_rec; reflexivity ].
        -
The end of a shape: the right index at ups', related to the one at u1 through the one at ups.
          intros * E E' O O' Hr IHr Mk ms ms' c gs1 t0 gs2 ws ws' kk ys ys' Hu HM Hρ Hρ' Hn Hc Hw Hs Hk Hy HTs.
          subst u'.
          destruct (ptyp_skip_self _ _ _ _ Hs) as (Hkd & Hj & HPs).
          rewrite shape_doms_tele_firstn_all in HTs by exact Hkd; subst Ts.
          assert (Hyf : tele_rel (shape_doms_rel (doms_rel k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) ms ws t0) (ptyp_doms t0) ys ys')
            by (destruct Hy as [Hyl Hya]; split; [ lia | exact Hya ]).
          subst pre pre' j Ps.
          destruct (adm_rec_params _ _ _ _ _ _ Hu1 k Mk ms ms' c _ gs1 t0 gs2 ws ws' ys ys' HM Hn Hc eq_refl Hw Hyf)
            as [b0 b1 F0 F1 R1].
          destruct (adm_rec_params _ _ _ _ _ _ Hcl k Mk ms ms' c _ gs1 t0 gs2 ws ws' ys ys' HM Hn Hc eq_refl Hw Hyf)
            as [b0' b2 F0' F2 R2].
          pose proof (functional_eval_exps' _ _ _ _ F0 F0') as <-.
          pose proof (functional_eval_exps' _ _ _ _ F1 E') as ->.
          pose proof (nparams_tele_rel_trans _ _ _ _ (nparams_tele_rel_sym _ _ _ R1) R2) as R12.
          econstructor; [ exact E | exact F2 | exact O | |].
          + destruct O' as [idx Ei Ri]; exists idx; [ exact Ei | exact (nparams_tele_rel_trans _ _ _ _ Ri R12) ].
          + destruct (nparams_tele_rel_member _ _ _ R12) as (Mj & HMj & H12).
            pose proof (IHr eq_refl) as Hr'.
            destruct (nparams_tele_rel_member _ _ _ (nparams_tele_rel_refl_l _ _ _ R12)) as (Mj' & HMj' & _).
            eapply (ind_rel_idx _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMj Hr'); [| exact H12 ].
            destruct O as [idx0 Ei0 Ri0].
            destruct (nparams_tele_rel_member _ _ _ (nparams_tele_rel_refl_r _ _ _ Ri0)) as (Mj0 & HMj0 & H00).
            rewrite HMj in HMj0; injection HMj0 as <-; exact H00.
        - intros * Hf IH Hfr Hfr' Mk ms ms' c gs1 t0 gs2 ws ws' k0 ys ys' Hu HM Hρ Hρ' Hn Hc Hw Hs Hk Hy HTs.
          pose proof (nparams_rel_refl_l _ _ HM _ _ Hn) as Hnn.
          destruct (shape_pi_step _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HM Hnn Hc Hw Hs Hy) as (HB & Hs' & Hk' & HP & Hstep).
          subst pre pre' Ts.
          constructor; [| exact Hfr | exact Hfr' ]; intros a a' Haa.
          apply (IH a a' Haa Mk ms ms' c gs1 t0 gs2 ws ws' (S k0) (ys ++ a :: nil) (ys' ++ a' :: nil) Hu HM);
            [ rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; reflexivity | rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; reflexivity
            | exact Hn | exact Hc | exact Hw | exact Hs' | exact Hk' | apply Hstep; exact Haa
            | apply prefix_tele_snoc_dom; exact HB ].
        - intros * Ef Ef' Hsh IH; intros.
          econstructor; [ exact Ef | exact Ef' | eapply IH; eassumption ].
      Qed.

The right base moved to ups' from any base: at the end of a shape, the right index is admissible (admissible_index_at), so it is related to the index at ups after the right prefix, which is related to the one after the left prefix (adm_rec_params at ups itself), and that one to the index at ups' (adm_rec_params at ups').
      Lemma ind_rel_rebase_r : adm_uparams D ups nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel ups ->
          (forall k u u' ns ns' x y, ind_rel p D (admissible_index_at D ups nparams_rel) nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel k u u' ns ns' x y ->
             ind_rel p D (admissible_index_at D ups nparams_rel) nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel k u ups' ns ns' x y) /\
          (forall k u u' pre pre' Ts gs vs vs',
             con_args_rel p D (admissible_index_at D ups nparams_rel) nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel k u u' pre pre' Ts gs vs vs' ->
             forall Mk ms ms' c gsf gs1 vp vp', ind_member D k = Some Mk ->
               pre = ms ++ nonrec_arg_vals gs1 vp -> pre' = ms' ++ nonrec_arg_vals gs1 vp' ->
               List.length vp = List.length gs1 -> List.length vp' = List.length gs1 ->
               tele_rel (nparams_rel k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) ms ms' -> ind_con Mk c = Some gsf -> gsf = gs1 ++ gs ->
               tele_rel (args_rel k ms c) (cargs_nonrec gsf) (nonrec_arg_vals gsf (vp ++ vs)) (nonrec_arg_vals gsf (vp' ++ vs')) ->
               Ts = List.rev (im_nparams Mk) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1 ->
               con_args_rel p D (admissible_index_at D ups nparams_rel) nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel k u ups' pre pre' Ts gs vs vs') /\
          (forall k u u' pre pre' Ts t v v',
             rec_arg_rel p D (admissible_index_at D ups nparams_rel) nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel k u u' pre pre' Ts t v v' ->
             forall Mk ms ms' c gs1 t0 gs2 ws ws' kk ys ys', ind_member D k = Some Mk ->
               pre = ms ++ ws ++ ys -> pre' = ms' ++ ws' ++ ys' ->
               tele_rel (nparams_rel k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) ms ms' -> ind_con Mk c = Some (gs1 ++ ca_rec t0 :: gs2) ->
               tele_prefix_rel (args_rel k ms c) (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) ws ws' ->
               ptyp_skip kk t0 = t -> kk <= List.length (ptyp_doms t0) ->
               tele_prefix_rel (shape_doms_rel (doms_rel k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) ms ws t0) kk ys ys' ->
               Ts = List.rev (im_nparams Mk) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1 ++ List.firstn kk (shape_doms_tele t0) ->
               rec_arg_rel p D (admissible_index_at D ups nparams_rel) nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel k u ups' pre pre' Ts t v v') /\
          (forall k u u' pre pre' Ts t f a f' a',
             rec_arg_app_rel p D (admissible_index_at D ups nparams_rel) nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel k u u' pre pre' Ts t f a f' a' ->
             forall Mk ms ms' c gs1 t0 gs2 ws ws' kk ys ys', ind_member D k = Some Mk ->
               pre = ms ++ ws ++ ys -> pre' = ms' ++ ws' ++ ys' ->
               tele_rel (nparams_rel k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) ms ms' -> ind_con Mk c = Some (gs1 ++ ca_rec t0 :: gs2) ->
               tele_prefix_rel (args_rel k ms c) (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) ws ws' ->
               ptyp_skip kk t0 = t -> kk <= List.length (ptyp_doms t0) ->
               tele_prefix_rel (shape_doms_rel (doms_rel k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) ms ws t0) kk ys ys' ->
               Ts = List.rev (im_nparams Mk) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1 ++ List.firstn kk (shape_doms_tele t0) ->
               rec_arg_app_rel p D (admissible_index_at D ups nparams_rel) nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel k u ups' pre pre' Ts t f a f' a').
      Proof.
        intros Hcd; apply ind_rel_mut_ind_all.
        - intros * HM Hrv Hr Hn Hc Hb Hb' Hs Hs' Ha Hia IH.
          assert (Hm : tele_rel (nparams_rel k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) (List.skipn (im_unu D Mk) bs) (List.skipn (im_unu D Mk) bs'))
            by exact (nparams_rel_trans _ _ HM _ _ _ (nparams_rel_trans _ _ HM _ _ _ (nparams_rel_sym _ _ HM _ _ Hs) Hn) Hs').
          eapply ind_rel_con; try eassumption.
          apply (IH Mk (List.skipn (im_unu D Mk) bs) (List.skipn (im_unu D Mk) bs') c gs nil nil nil HM);
            cbn; rewrite ?List.app_nil_r; try reflexivity; assumption.
        - intros; eapply ind_rel_neut; eassumption.
        - intros * HM Hh Hnp Hcs Hp Hp' Ha Hia IH; rview_case_facts.
          eapply ind_rel_record; try eassumption.
          apply (IH Mk nil nil c gs nil nil nil HM); cbn; try reflexivity; try assumption; rewrite Hnp; reflexivity.
        - intros; constructor.
        - intros * Hia IH Mk ms ms' c gsf gs1 vp vp' HM Hρ Hρ' Hl Hl' Hn Hc Heq Ha HTs.
          constructor.
          apply (IH Mk ms ms' c gsf (gs1 ++ ca_arg r A :: nil) (vp ++ v :: nil) (vp' ++ v' :: nil) HM);
            [ rewrite Hρ, nonrec_arg_vals_snoc_arg, List.app_assoc by assumption; reflexivity
            | rewrite Hρ', nonrec_arg_vals_snoc_arg, List.app_assoc by assumption; reflexivity
            | rewrite !List.length_app; cbn; lia | rewrite !List.length_app; cbn; lia | assumption | assumption
            | rewrite Heq, <- List.app_assoc; reflexivity | rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; exact Ha
            | rewrite HTs, cargs_nonrec_tele_snoc_arg, List.app_assoc; reflexivity ].
        - intros * Hsh IHs Hia IH Mk ms ms' c gsf gs1 vp vp' HM Hρ Hρ' Hl Hl' Hn Hc Heq Ha HTs.
          pose proof (nonrec_prefix _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HM (nparams_rel_refl_l _ _ HM _ _ Hn) Hc Heq Hl Hl' Ha) as Hpre.
          constructor.
          + apply (IHs Mk ms ms' c gs1 t gs (nonrec_arg_vals gs1 vp) (nonrec_arg_vals gs1 vp') 0 nil nil HM);
              [ rewrite List.app_nil_r; exact Hρ | rewrite List.app_nil_r; exact Hρ' | exact Hn | rewrite <- Heq; exact Hc
              | exact Hpre | reflexivity | lia | apply tele_prefix_rel_nil | rewrite HTs; cbn; rewrite List.app_nil_r; reflexivity ].
          + apply (IH Mk ms ms' c gsf (gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: nil) (vp ++ v :: nil) (vp' ++ v' :: nil) HM);
              [ rewrite Hρ, nonrec_arg_vals_snoc_rec by assumption; reflexivity
              | rewrite Hρ', nonrec_arg_vals_snoc_rec by assumption; reflexivity
              | rewrite !List.length_app; cbn; lia | rewrite !List.length_app; cbn; lia | assumption | assumption
              | rewrite Heq, <- List.app_assoc; reflexivity | rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; exact Ha
              | rewrite HTs, cargs_nonrec_tele_snoc_rec; reflexivity ].
        -
The end of a shape.
          intros * E E' O O' Hr IHr Mk ms ms' c gs1 t0 gs2 ws ws' kk ys ys' HM Hρ Hρ' Hn Hc Hw Hs Hk Hy HTs.
          destruct (ptyp_skip_self _ _ _ _ Hs) as (Hkd & Hj & HPs).
          rewrite shape_doms_tele_firstn_all in HTs by exact Hkd; subst Ts.
          assert (Hyf : tele_rel (shape_doms_rel (doms_rel k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) ms ws t0) (ptyp_doms t0) ys ys')
            by (destruct Hy as [Hyl Hya]; split; [ lia | exact Hya ]).
          subst pre pre' j Ps.
          destruct (adm_rec_params _ _ _ _ _ _ Hcd k Mk ms ms' c _ gs1 t0 gs2 ws ws' ys ys' HM Hn Hc eq_refl Hw Hyf)
            as [b0 b1 F0 F1 R1].
          destruct (adm_rec_params _ _ _ _ _ _ Hcl k Mk ms ms' c _ gs1 t0 gs2 ws ws' ys ys' HM Hn Hc eq_refl Hw Hyf)
            as [b0' b2 F0' F2 R2].
          pose proof (functional_eval_exps' _ _ _ _ F0 F0') as <-.
          destruct O' as [idx Ei Ri].
          pose proof (functional_eval_exps' _ _ _ _ F1 Ei) as <-.
          pose proof (nparams_tele_rel_trans _ _ _ _ (nparams_tele_rel_sym _ _ _ R1) R2) as R12.
          pose proof (nparams_tele_rel_trans _ _ _ _ (nparams_tele_rel_sym _ _ _ Ri) R12) as R'2.
          econstructor; [ exact E | exact F2 | exact O | exists b1; [ exact F1 | exact R12 ] |].
          destruct (nparams_tele_rel_member _ _ _ R'2) as (Mj & HMj & H'2).
          eapply (ind_rel_idx _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMj IHr); [| exact H'2 ].
          destruct O as [idx0 Ei0 Ri0].
          destruct (nparams_tele_rel_member _ _ _ (nparams_tele_rel_refl_r _ _ _ Ri0)) as (Mj0 & HMj0 & H00).
          rewrite HMj in HMj0; injection HMj0 as <-; exact H00.
        - intros * Hf IH Hfr Hfr' Mk ms ms' c gs1 t0 gs2 ws ws' k0 ys ys' HM Hρ Hρ' Hn Hc Hw Hs Hk Hy HTs.
          pose proof (nparams_rel_refl_l _ _ HM _ _ Hn) as Hnn.
          destruct (shape_pi_step _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HM Hnn Hc Hw Hs Hy) as (HB & Hs' & Hk' & HP & Hstep).
          subst pre pre' Ts.
          constructor; [| exact Hfr | exact Hfr' ]; intros a a' Haa.
          apply (IH a a' Haa Mk ms ms' c gs1 t0 gs2 ws ws' (S k0) (ys ++ a :: nil) (ys' ++ a' :: nil) HM);
            [ rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; reflexivity | rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; reflexivity
            | exact Hn | exact Hc | exact Hw | exact Hs' | exact Hk' | apply Hstep; exact Haa
            | apply prefix_tele_snoc_dom; exact HB ].
        - intros * Ef Ef' Hsh IH; intros.
          econstructor; [ exact Ef | exact Ef' | eapply IH; eassumption ].
      Qed.

The right element's prefix moved to a related one: at the end of a shape, the right parameters at the new prefix are related to those at the old one through the ones at ups (adm_rec_params at ups' and, for the new prefix's own index, at ups).
      Lemma ind_rel_pre_r : adm_uparams D ups nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel ups ->
          (forall k u u' ns ns' x y, ind_rel p D (admissible_index_at D ups nparams_rel) nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel k u u' ns ns' x y ->
             True) /\
          (forall k u u' pre pre' Ts gs vs vs',
             con_args_rel p D (admissible_index_at D ups nparams_rel) nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel k u u' pre pre' Ts gs vs vs' -> True) /\
          (forall k u u' pre pre' Ts t v v',
             rec_arg_rel p D (admissible_index_at D ups nparams_rel) nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel k u u' pre pre' Ts t v v' ->
             forall Mk ms ms' ms'' c gs1 t0 gs2 ws ws' ws'' kk ys ys' ys'', u' = ups' -> ind_member D k = Some Mk ->
               pre = ms ++ ws ++ ys -> pre' = ms' ++ ws' ++ ys' ->
               tele_rel (nparams_rel k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) ms ms' ->
               tele_rel (nparams_rel k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) ms' ms'' ->
               ind_con Mk c = Some (gs1 ++ ca_rec t0 :: gs2) ->
               tele_prefix_rel (args_rel k ms c) (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) ws ws' ->
               tele_prefix_rel (args_rel k ms' c) (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) ws' ws'' ->
               ptyp_skip kk t0 = t -> kk <= List.length (ptyp_doms t0) ->
               tele_prefix_rel (shape_doms_rel (doms_rel k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) ms ws t0) kk ys ys' ->
               tele_prefix_rel (shape_doms_rel (doms_rel k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) ms' ws' t0) kk ys' ys'' ->
               Ts = List.rev (im_nparams Mk) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1 ++ List.firstn kk (shape_doms_tele t0) ->
               rec_arg_rel p D (admissible_index_at D ups nparams_rel) nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel k u u' pre (ms'' ++ ws'' ++ ys'') Ts t v v') /\
          (forall k u u' pre pre' Ts t f a f' a',
             rec_arg_app_rel p D (admissible_index_at D ups nparams_rel) nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel k u u' pre pre' Ts t f a f' a' ->
             forall Mk ms ms' ms'' c gs1 t0 gs2 ws ws' ws'' kk ys ys' ys'', u' = ups' -> ind_member D k = Some Mk ->
               pre = ms ++ ws ++ ys -> pre' = ms' ++ ws' ++ ys' ->
               tele_rel (nparams_rel k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) ms ms' ->
               tele_rel (nparams_rel k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) ms' ms'' ->
               ind_con Mk c = Some (gs1 ++ ca_rec t0 :: gs2) ->
               tele_prefix_rel (args_rel k ms c) (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) ws ws' ->
               tele_prefix_rel (args_rel k ms' c) (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) ws' ws'' ->
               ptyp_skip kk t0 = t -> kk <= List.length (ptyp_doms t0) ->
               tele_prefix_rel (shape_doms_rel (doms_rel k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) ms ws t0) kk ys ys' ->
               tele_prefix_rel (shape_doms_rel (doms_rel k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) ms' ws' t0) kk ys' ys'' ->
               Ts = List.rev (im_nparams Mk) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1 ++ List.firstn kk (shape_doms_tele t0) ->
               rec_arg_app_rel p D (admissible_index_at D ups nparams_rel) nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel k u u' pre (ms'' ++ ws'' ++ ys'') Ts t f a f' a').
      Proof.
        intros Hcd; apply ind_rel_mut_ind_all; try (intros; exact I).
        -
The end of a shape.
          intros * E E' O O' Hr _ Mk ms ms' ms'' c gs1 t0 gs2 ws ws' ws'' kk ys ys' ys'' Hu HM Hρ Hρ' Hn Hn' Hc Hw Hw' Hs Hk Hy Hy' HTs.
          subst u'.
          destruct (ptyp_skip_self _ _ _ _ Hs) as (Hkd & Hj & HPs).
          rewrite shape_doms_tele_firstn_all in HTs by exact Hkd; subst Ts.
          assert (HK : List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1) <= List.length (cargs_nonrec (gs1 ++ ca_rec t0 :: gs2)))
            by (rewrite cargs_nonrec_app, List.length_app; lia).
          assert (Hfull : forall a b ma wa, tele_prefix_rel (shape_doms_rel (doms_rel k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) ma wa t0) kk a b ->
                     tele_rel (shape_doms_rel (doms_rel k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) ma wa t0) (ptyp_doms t0) a b)
            by (intros * H; destruct H as [Hyl Hya]; split; [ lia | exact Hya ]).
          pose proof (nparams_rel_refl_r _ _ HM _ _ Hn) as Hn1.
          pose proof (nparams_rel_refl_r _ _ HM _ _ Hn') as Hn2.
          pose proof (args_prefix_rel_refl_r _ _ HM _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hn Hc HK Hw) as Hw1.
          pose proof (args_prefix_rel_refl_r _ _ HM _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hn' Hc HK Hw') as Hw2.
          assert (Hy1 : tele_prefix_rel (shape_doms_rel (doms_rel k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) ms' ws' t0) kk ys' ys')
            by (eapply (doms_rel_refl_inst _ _ HM); [ exact Hn | exact Hc | reflexivity | exact Hw | exact Hk | exact Hy ]).
          assert (Hy2 : tele_prefix_rel (shape_doms_rel (doms_rel k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) ms'' ws'' t0) kk ys'' ys'')
            by (eapply (doms_rel_refl_inst _ _ HM); [ exact Hn' | exact Hc | reflexivity | exact Hw' | exact Hk | exact Hy' ]).
          subst pre pre' j Ps.
The old and the new right parameters, through those at ups.
          destruct (adm_rec_params _ _ _ _ _ _ Hcl k Mk ms' ms'' c _ gs1 t0 gs2 ws' ws'' ys' ys'' HM Hn' Hc eq_refl Hw'
                      (Hfull _ _ _ _ Hy')) as [b0 b2 F0 F2 R02].
          destruct (adm_rec_params _ _ _ _ _ _ Hcl k Mk ms' ms' c _ gs1 t0 gs2 ws' ws' ys' ys' HM Hn1 Hc eq_refl Hw1
                      (Hfull _ _ _ _ Hy1)) as [b0' b1 F0' F1 R01].
          pose proof (functional_eval_exps' _ _ _ _ F0 F0') as <-.
          pose proof (functional_eval_exps' _ _ _ _ F1 E') as ->.
          pose proof (nparams_tele_rel_trans _ _ _ _ (nparams_tele_rel_sym _ _ _ R01) R02) as R12.
          econstructor; [ exact E | exact F2 | exact O | |].
          + destruct (adm_rec_params _ _ _ _ _ _ Hcl k Mk ms'' ms'' c _ gs1 t0 gs2 ws'' ws'' ys'' ys'' HM Hn2 Hc eq_refl Hw2
                        (Hfull _ _ _ _ Hy2)) as [i0 i2 G0 G2 Q02].
            pose proof (functional_eval_exps' _ _ _ _ G2 F2) as ->.
            exact (mk_admissible_index_at _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ G0 Q02).
          + destruct (nparams_tele_rel_member _ _ _ R12) as (Mj & HMj & H12).
            eapply (ind_rel_idx _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMj Hr); [| exact H12 ].
            destruct O as [idx0 Ei0 Ri0].
            destruct (nparams_tele_rel_member _ _ _ (nparams_tele_rel_refl_r _ _ _ Ri0)) as (Mj0 & HMj0 & H00).
            rewrite HMj in HMj0; injection HMj0 as <-; exact H00.
        -
A domain of a shape: the new prefix extended by the right argument, related to itself at the old one's domain.
          intros * Hf IH Hfr Hfr' Mk ms ms' ms'' c gs1 t0 gs2 ws ws' ws'' k0 ys ys' ys'' Hu HM Hρ Hρ' Hn Hn' Hc Hw Hw' Hs Hk Hy Hy' HTs.
          pose proof (nparams_rel_refl_l _ _ HM _ _ Hn) as Hnn.
          pose proof (nparams_rel_refl_l _ _ HM _ _ Hn') as Hnn'.
          destruct (shape_pi_step _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HM Hnn Hc Hw Hs Hy) as (HB & Hs' & Hk' & HP & Hstep).
          destruct (shape_pi_step _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HM Hnn' Hc Hw' Hs Hy') as (_ & _ & _ & HP' & Hstep').
          subst pre pre' Ts.
          constructor; [| exact Hfr | exact Hfr' ]; intros a a' Haa.
          assert (Ha'a' : doms_rel k (ms ++ ws ++ ys) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1 ++ List.firstn k0 (shape_doms_tele t0)) B a' a') by (etransitivity; [ symmetry; exact Haa | exact Haa ]).
          pose proof (proj1 (HdI _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HM Hn Hc eq_refl Hw HB Hy _ _) Ha'a') as Ha'.
          replace ((ms'' ++ ws'' ++ ys'') ++ a' :: nil) with (ms'' ++ ws'' ++ ys'' ++ a' :: nil)
            by (rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; reflexivity).
          apply (IH a a' Haa Mk ms ms' ms'' c gs1 t0 gs2 ws ws' ws'' (S k0) (ys ++ a :: nil) (ys' ++ a' :: nil)
                   (ys'' ++ a' :: nil) Hu HM); [ rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; reflexivity | rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; reflexivity
                   | exact Hn | exact Hn' | exact Hc | exact Hw | exact Hw' | exact Hs' | exact Hk' | apply Hstep; exact Haa
                   | apply Hstep'; exact Ha' | apply prefix_tele_snoc_dom; exact HB ].
        - intros * Ef Ef' Hsh IH; intros.
          econstructor; [ exact Ef | exact Ef' | eapply IH; eassumption ].
      Qed.
    End FreshBase.

Both types' bases moved, all admissible beside ups: the right one by ind_rel_base_r, the left one by it between two swaps.
    Lemma ind_rel_bases : forall k u1 u2 v1 v2 ns ns' x y,
        adm_uparams D ups nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel u1 -> adm_uparams D ups nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel u2 ->
        adm_uparams D ups nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel v1 -> adm_uparams D ups nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel v2 ->
        ind_rel p D (admissible_index_at D ups nparams_rel) nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel k u1 u2 ns ns' x y ->
        ind_rel p D (admissible_index_at D ups nparams_rel) nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel k v1 v2 ns ns' x y.
    Proof.
      intros * H1 H2 H3 H4 H.
      pose proof (proj1 (ind_rel_base_r v2 H4 u2 H2) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H eq_refl) as Hr.
      pose proof (proj1 (ind_rel_sym_all _) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hr) as Hs.
      pose proof (proj1 (ind_rel_base_r v1 H3 u1 H1) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hs eq_refl) as Hr'.
      exact (proj1 (ind_rel_sym_all _) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hr').
    Qed.

Both bases moved from any bases to ones admissible beside ups, when ups is admissible beside itself (ind_rel_rebase_r).
    Lemma ind_rel_rebase : forall k u u' v1 v2 ns ns' x y,
        adm_uparams D ups nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel ups ->
        adm_uparams D ups nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel v1 -> adm_uparams D ups nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel v2 ->
        ind_rel p D (admissible_index_at D ups nparams_rel) nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel k u u' ns ns' x y ->
        ind_rel p D (admissible_index_at D ups nparams_rel) nparams_rel args_rel doms_rel k v1 v2 ns ns' x y.
    Proof.
      intros * Hcd H1 H2 H.
      pose proof (proj1 (ind_rel_rebase_r v2 H2 Hcd) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H) as Hr.
      pose proof (proj1 (ind_rel_sym_all _) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hr) as Hs.
      pose proof (proj1 (ind_rel_rebase_r v1 H1 Hcd) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hs) as Hr'.
      exact (proj1 (ind_rel_sym_all _) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hr').
    Qed.
  End IndPER.

Changing the Relations

The elements depend on the relations only where they are used: at the left parameters and arguments.
  Section FamChange.
    #[local] Set Default Proof Using "All".
    Variable (p : qname) (D : ind_decl) (ups : list domain).
    Variable (nparams_rel1 nparams_rel2 : nat -> nat -> list domain -> relation domain).
    Variable (args_rel1 args_rel2 : nat -> list domain -> String.string -> nat -> list domain -> relation domain).
    Variable (doms_rel1 doms_rel2 : nat -> list domain -> list centry -> exp -> relation domain).
    Hypothesis (Hn : forall m Mm k vs vs1 vs2, ind_member D m = Some Mm -> k < List.length (List.rev (im_nparams Mm)) ->
                     tele_prefix_rel (nparams_rel1 m) k vs vs1 -> tele_prefix_rel (nparams_rel2 m) k vs vs2 ->
                     (nparams_rel1 m k vs <~> nparams_rel2 m k vs)).
    Hypothesis (Ha : forall m Mm ms ms1 ms2 c gs k vs vs1 vs2, ind_member D m = Some Mm ->
                     tele_rel (nparams_rel1 m) (List.rev (im_nparams Mm)) ms ms1 -> tele_rel (nparams_rel2 m) (List.rev (im_nparams Mm)) ms ms2 ->
                     ind_con Mm c = Some gs -> k < List.length (cargs_nonrec gs) ->
                     tele_prefix_rel (args_rel1 m ms c) k vs vs1 -> tele_prefix_rel (args_rel2 m ms c) k vs vs2 ->
                     (args_rel1 m ms c k vs <~> args_rel2 m ms c k vs)).
    Hypothesis (Hd : forall m Mm ms ms1 ms2 c gs gs1 t gs2 ws ws1 ws2 k ys ys1 ys2, ind_member D m = Some Mm ->
                     tele_rel (nparams_rel1 m) (List.rev (im_nparams Mm)) ms ms1 -> tele_rel (nparams_rel2 m) (List.rev (im_nparams Mm)) ms ms2 ->
                     ind_con Mm c = Some gs -> gs = gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: gs2 ->
                     tele_prefix_rel (args_rel1 m ms c) (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) ws ws1 ->
                     tele_prefix_rel (args_rel2 m ms c) (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) ws ws2 ->
                     k < List.length (ptyp_doms t) ->
                     tele_prefix_rel (shape_doms_rel (doms_rel1 m) (List.rev (im_nparams Mm)) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) ms ws t) k ys ys1 ->
                     tele_prefix_rel (shape_doms_rel (doms_rel2 m) (List.rev (im_nparams Mm)) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) ms ws t) k ys ys2 ->
                     (shape_doms_rel (doms_rel1 m) (List.rev (im_nparams Mm)) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) ms ws t k ys <~> shape_doms_rel (doms_rel2 m) (List.rev (im_nparams Mm)) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) ms ws t k ys)).

    Section Member.
      Variable (m : nat) (Mm : imember).
      Hypothesis (HM : ind_member D m = Some Mm).
      Let T := List.rev (im_nparams Mm).

    Lemma tele_rel_nr_change : forall a b, tele_rel (nparams_rel1 m) T a b -> tele_rel (nparams_rel2 m) T a b.
    Proof. intros * H; apply (tele_rel_map T (nparams_rel1 m)); [| exact H ]; intros; eapply Hn; eassumption. Qed.

    Lemma tele_rel_nr_change' : forall a b, tele_rel (nparams_rel2 m) T a b -> tele_rel (nparams_rel1 m) T a b.
    Proof. intros * H; apply (tele_rel_map T (nparams_rel2 m)); [| exact H ]; intros; eapply Hn; eassumption. Qed.

    Lemma tele_prefix_rel_nr_change : forall k a b, k <= List.length T -> tele_prefix_rel (nparams_rel1 m) k a b ->
        tele_prefix_rel (nparams_rel2 m) k a b.
    Proof.
      intros * Hk H; rewrite tele_prefix_rel_full_iff in H |- *.
      apply (tele_rel_map _ (nparams_rel1 m)); [| exact H ].
      intros j pa pb x y Hj Hp1 Hp2 Hr; rewrite List.repeat_length in Hj.
      eapply Hn; [ exact HM | unfold T in *; lia | exact Hp1 | exact Hp2 | exact Hr ].
    Qed.

    Lemma tele_prefix_rel_nr_change' : forall k a b, k <= List.length T -> tele_prefix_rel (nparams_rel2 m) k a b ->
        tele_prefix_rel (nparams_rel1 m) k a b.
    Proof.
      intros * Hk H; rewrite tele_prefix_rel_full_iff in H |- *.
      apply (tele_rel_map _ (nparams_rel2 m)); [| exact H ].
      intros j pa pb x y Hj Hp1 Hp2 Hr; rewrite List.repeat_length in Hj.
      eapply Hn; [ exact HM | unfold T in *; lia | exact Hp2 | exact Hp1 | exact Hr ].
    Qed.

    Lemma tele_prefix_rel_ar_change' : forall ms ms1 ms2 c gs k a b,
        tele_rel (nparams_rel1 m) T ms ms1 -> tele_rel (nparams_rel2 m) T ms ms2 ->
        ind_con Mm c = Some gs -> k <= List.length (cargs_nonrec gs) ->
        tele_prefix_rel (args_rel2 m ms c) k a b -> tele_prefix_rel (args_rel1 m ms c) k a b.
    Proof.
      intros * Hm1 Hm2 Hc Hk H; rewrite tele_prefix_rel_full_iff in H |- *.
      apply (tele_rel_map _ (args_rel2 m ms c)); [| exact H ].
      intros j pa pb x y Hj Hp1 Hp2 Hr; rewrite List.repeat_length in Hj.
      eapply Ha; [ exact HM | exact Hm1 | exact Hm2 | exact Hc | lia | exact Hp2 | exact Hp1 | exact Hr ].
    Qed.

    Lemma tele_prefix_rel_ar_change : forall ms ms1 ms2 c gs k a b,
        tele_rel (nparams_rel1 m) T ms ms1 -> tele_rel (nparams_rel2 m) T ms ms2 ->
        ind_con Mm c = Some gs -> k <= List.length (cargs_nonrec gs) ->
        tele_prefix_rel (args_rel1 m ms c) k a b -> tele_prefix_rel (args_rel2 m ms c) k a b.
    Proof.
      intros * Hm1 Hm2 Hc Hk H; rewrite tele_prefix_rel_full_iff in H |- *.
      apply (tele_rel_map _ (args_rel1 m ms c)); [| exact H ].
      intros j pa pb x y Hj Hp1 Hp2 Hr; rewrite List.repeat_length in Hj.
      eapply Ha; [ exact HM | exact Hm1 | exact Hm2 | exact Hc | lia | exact Hp1 | exact Hp2 | exact Hr ].
    Qed.

    Lemma tele_prefix_rel_sh_change : forall ms ms1 ms2 c gs gs1 t gs2 ws ws1 ws2 k a b,
        tele_rel (nparams_rel1 m) T ms ms1 -> tele_rel (nparams_rel2 m) T ms ms2 -> ind_con Mm c = Some gs -> gs = gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: gs2 ->
        tele_prefix_rel (args_rel1 m ms c) (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) ws ws1 ->
        tele_prefix_rel (args_rel2 m ms c) (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) ws ws2 -> k <= List.length (ptyp_doms t) ->
        tele_prefix_rel (shape_doms_rel (doms_rel1 m) (List.rev (im_nparams Mm)) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) ms ws t) k a b ->
        tele_prefix_rel (shape_doms_rel (doms_rel2 m) (List.rev (im_nparams Mm)) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) ms ws t) k a b.
    Proof.
      intros * Hm1 Hm2 Hc Heq Hw1 Hw2 Hk H; rewrite tele_prefix_rel_full_iff in H |- *.
      apply (tele_rel_map _ (shape_doms_rel (doms_rel1 m) (List.rev (im_nparams Mm)) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) ms ws t)); [| exact H ].
      intros j pa pb x y Hj Hp1 Hp2 Hr; rewrite List.repeat_length in Hj.
      eapply Hd; [ exact HM | exact Hm1 | exact Hm2 | exact Hc | exact Heq | exact Hw1 | exact Hw2 | lia | exact Hp1 | exact Hp2 | exact Hr ].
    Qed.

    Lemma tele_prefix_rel_sh_change' : forall ms ms1 ms2 c gs gs1 t gs2 ws ws1 ws2 k a b,
        tele_rel (nparams_rel1 m) T ms ms1 -> tele_rel (nparams_rel2 m) T ms ms2 -> ind_con Mm c = Some gs -> gs = gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: gs2 ->
        tele_prefix_rel (args_rel1 m ms c) (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) ws ws1 ->
        tele_prefix_rel (args_rel2 m ms c) (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) ws ws2 -> k <= List.length (ptyp_doms t) ->
        tele_prefix_rel (shape_doms_rel (doms_rel2 m) (List.rev (im_nparams Mm)) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) ms ws t) k a b ->
        tele_prefix_rel (shape_doms_rel (doms_rel1 m) (List.rev (im_nparams Mm)) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) ms ws t) k a b.
    Proof.
      intros * Hm1 Hm2 Hc Heq Hw1 Hw2 Hk H; rewrite tele_prefix_rel_full_iff in H |- *.
      apply (tele_rel_map _ (shape_doms_rel (doms_rel2 m) (List.rev (im_nparams Mm)) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) ms ws t)); [| exact H ].
      intros j pa pb x y Hj Hp1 Hp2 Hr; rewrite List.repeat_length in Hj.
      eapply Hd; [ exact HM | exact Hm1 | exact Hm2 | exact Hc | exact Heq | exact Hw1 | exact Hw2 | lia | exact Hp2 | exact Hp1 | exact Hr ].
    Qed.
    End Member.

    Lemma nparams_tele_rel_nr_change : forall j a b, nparams_tele_rel D nparams_rel1 j a b -> nparams_tele_rel D nparams_rel2 j a b.
    Proof.
      unfold nparams_tele_rel; intros j a b; destruct (ind_member D j) as [Mj |] eqn:Hj; [| auto ].
      exact (tele_rel_nr_change _ _ Hj a b).
    Qed.

    Lemma admissible_index_at_change : forall j pre Ts Ps bs,
        admissible_index_at D ups nparams_rel1 j pre Ts Ps bs -> admissible_index_at D ups nparams_rel2 j pre Ts Ps bs.
    Proof. intros * [idx E R]; exists idx; [ exact E | exact (nparams_tele_rel_nr_change _ _ _ R) ]. Qed.

    Lemma adm_change : forall ua, adm_uparams D ups nparams_rel1 args_rel1 doms_rel1 ua -> adm_uparams D ups nparams_rel2 args_rel2 doms_rel2 ua.
    Proof.
      intros ua [H1 H2 H3 H4]; constructor.
      - intros m Mm k κ A vs vs' HM Hk Hp.
        assert (Hkl : k < List.length (List.rev (im_nparams Mm))) by (apply List.nth_error_Some; congruence).
        pose proof (tele_prefix_rel_nr_change' _ _ HM k vs vs' ltac:(lia) Hp) as Hp1.
        exact (rel_component_types_resp _ _ _ _ _ (Hn _ _ _ _ _ _ HM Hkl Hp1 Hp) (H1 _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HM Hk Hp1)).
      - intros m Mm ms ms' c gs k A vs vs' HM Hm Hc Hk Hp.
        assert (Hkl : k < List.length (cargs_nonrec gs)) by (apply List.nth_error_Some; congruence).
        pose proof (tele_rel_nr_change' _ _ HM _ _ Hm) as Hm1.
        pose proof (tele_prefix_rel_ar_change' _ _ HM ms ms' ms' c gs k vs vs' Hm1 Hm Hc ltac:(lia) Hp) as Hp1.
        exact (rel_component_types_resp _ _ _ _ _ (Ha _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HM Hm1 Hm Hc Hkl Hp1 Hp)
                 (H2 _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HM Hm1 Hc Hk Hp1)).
      - intros m Mm ms ms' c gs gs1 t gs2 ws ws' ys ys' HM Hm Hc Heq Hp Hy.
        assert (Hk : List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1) <= List.length (cargs_nonrec gs))
          by (rewrite Heq, cargs_nonrec_app, List.length_app; lia).
        pose proof (tele_rel_nr_change' _ _ HM _ _ Hm) as Hm1.
        pose proof (tele_prefix_rel_ar_change' _ _ HM _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hm1 Hm Hc Hk Hp) as Hp1.
        assert (Hy1 : tele_rel (shape_doms_rel (doms_rel1 m) (List.rev (im_nparams Mm)) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) ms ws t) (ptyp_doms t) ys ys').
        { apply tele_rel_of_pre; eapply (tele_prefix_rel_sh_change' _ _ HM);
            [ exact Hm1 | exact Hm | exact Hc | exact Heq | exact Hp1 | exact Hp | lia | apply tele_rel_pre; exact Hy ]. }
        destruct (H3 _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HM Hm1 Hc Heq Hp1 Hy1) as [bs bs' E E' R].
        exists bs bs'; [ exact E | exact E' | exact (nparams_tele_rel_nr_change _ _ _ R) ].
      - intros m Mm ms ms' c gs gs1 t gs2 ws ws' k B ys ys' HM Hm Hc Heq Hp HB Hy.
        assert (Hk : List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1) <= List.length (cargs_nonrec gs))
          by (rewrite Heq, cargs_nonrec_app, List.length_app; lia).
        assert (Hkl : k < List.length (ptyp_doms t)) by (apply List.nth_error_Some; congruence).
        pose proof (tele_rel_nr_change' _ _ HM _ _ Hm) as Hm1.
        pose proof (tele_prefix_rel_ar_change' _ _ HM _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hm1 Hm Hc Hk Hp) as Hp1.
        pose proof (tele_prefix_rel_sh_change' _ _ HM ms ms' ms' c gs gs1 t gs2 ws ws' ws' k ys ys' Hm1 Hm Hc Heq Hp1 Hp ltac:(lia) Hy) as Hy1.
        pose proof (Hd _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HM Hm1 Hm Hc Heq Hp1 Hp Hkl Hy1 Hy) as Hdd.
        unfold shape_doms_rel in Hdd; rewrite (List.nth_error_nth _ _ _ HB) in Hdd.
        destruct (H4 _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HM Hm1 Hc Heq Hp1 HB Hy1) as [a a' E E' Ht Hr Hr' Ty V].
        exists a a'; [ exact E | exact E' | | exact Hr | exact Hr' | exact Ty |].
        + intros x x' Hx; exact (Ht _ _ (proj2 (Hdd _ _) Hx)).
        + intros s; exact (proj1 (Hdd _ _) (V s)).
    Qed.

Changing the relations and the admissible bases; Hr1 is the reflexivity of nparams_rel1 on the right, which puts an element's own non-uniform parameters on the diagonal.
    Lemma ind_rel_change : forall (okr1 okr2 : nat -> list domain -> list centry -> list exp -> list domain -> Prop),
      (forall j pre Ts Ps bs, okr1 j pre Ts Ps bs -> okr2 j pre Ts Ps bs) ->
      (forall m Mm a b, ind_member D m = Some Mm ->
         tele_rel (nparams_rel1 m) (List.rev (im_nparams Mm)) a b -> tele_rel (nparams_rel1 m) (List.rev (im_nparams Mm)) b b) ->
      (forall k u u' ns ns' x y, ind_rel p D okr1 nparams_rel1 args_rel1 doms_rel1 k u u' ns ns' x y ->
         ind_rel p D okr2 nparams_rel2 args_rel2 doms_rel2 k u u' ns ns' x y) /\
      (forall k u u' pre pre' Ts gs vs vs', con_args_rel p D okr1 nparams_rel1 args_rel1 doms_rel1 k u u' pre pre' Ts gs vs vs' ->
         forall Mk ms c gsf gs1 vp vp', ind_member D k = Some Mk -> pre = ms ++ nonrec_arg_vals gs1 vp ->
           List.length vp = List.length gs1 -> List.length vp' = List.length gs1 ->
           tele_rel (nparams_rel1 k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) ms ms -> ind_con Mk c = Some gsf -> gsf = gs1 ++ gs ->
           tele_rel (args_rel1 k ms c) (cargs_nonrec gsf) (nonrec_arg_vals gsf (vp ++ vs)) (nonrec_arg_vals gsf (vp' ++ vs')) ->
           Ts = List.rev (im_nparams Mk) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1 ->
           con_args_rel p D okr2 nparams_rel2 args_rel2 doms_rel2 k u u' pre pre' Ts gs vs vs') /\
      (forall k u u' pre pre' Ts t v v', rec_arg_rel p D okr1 nparams_rel1 args_rel1 doms_rel1 k u u' pre pre' Ts t v v' ->
         forall Mk ms c gs1 t0 gs2 ws ws' kk ys ys', ind_member D k = Some Mk -> pre = ms ++ ws ++ ys ->
           tele_rel (nparams_rel1 k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) ms ms -> ind_con Mk c = Some (gs1 ++ ca_rec t0 :: gs2) ->
           tele_prefix_rel (args_rel1 k ms c) (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) ws ws' ->
           ptyp_skip kk t0 = t -> kk <= List.length (ptyp_doms t0) ->
           tele_prefix_rel (shape_doms_rel (doms_rel1 k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) ms ws t0) kk ys ys' ->
           Ts = List.rev (im_nparams Mk) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1 ++ List.firstn kk (shape_doms_tele t0) ->
           rec_arg_rel p D okr2 nparams_rel2 args_rel2 doms_rel2 k u u' pre pre' Ts t v v') /\
      (forall k u u' pre pre' Ts t f a f' a', rec_arg_app_rel p D okr1 nparams_rel1 args_rel1 doms_rel1 k u u' pre pre' Ts t f a f' a' ->
         forall Mk ms c gs1 t0 gs2 ws ws' kk ys ys', ind_member D k = Some Mk -> pre = ms ++ ws ++ ys ->
           tele_rel (nparams_rel1 k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) ms ms -> ind_con Mk c = Some (gs1 ++ ca_rec t0 :: gs2) ->
           tele_prefix_rel (args_rel1 k ms c) (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) ws ws' ->
           ptyp_skip kk t0 = t -> kk <= List.length (ptyp_doms t0) ->
           tele_prefix_rel (shape_doms_rel (doms_rel1 k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) ms ws t0) kk ys ys' ->
           Ts = List.rev (im_nparams Mk) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1 ++ List.firstn kk (shape_doms_tele t0) ->
           rec_arg_app_rel p D okr2 nparams_rel2 args_rel2 doms_rel2 k u u' pre pre' Ts t f a f' a').
    Proof.
      intros okr1 okr2 HK Hr1; apply ind_rel_mut_ind_all.
      - intros * HM Hrv Hr Hns Hc Hb Hb' Hs Hs' Har Hia IH.
        pose proof (Hr1 _ _ _ _ HM Hs) as Hss.
        eapply ind_rel_con; try eassumption; try (apply (tele_rel_nr_change _ _ HM); eassumption).
        + apply (tele_rel_map _ (args_rel1 k (List.skipn (im_unu D Mk) bs) c)); [| eassumption ].
          intros; eapply Ha; try eassumption; apply (tele_rel_nr_change _ _ HM); eassumption.
        + apply (IH Mk (List.skipn (im_unu D Mk) bs) c gs nil nil nil HM);
            [ cbn; rewrite List.app_nil_r; reflexivity | reflexivity | reflexivity | exact Hss | exact Hc | reflexivity | exact Har
            | apply prefix_tele_con_start ].
      - intros * HM Hrv Hh Hn1 L1 L2 H1 H2 Hm.
        eapply ind_rel_neut; try eassumption; try (apply (tele_rel_nr_change _ _ HM); eassumption); apply HO; eassumption.
      - intros * HM Hh Hnp Hcs Hp Hp' Har Hia IH.
        pose proof (ind_con_single _ _ _ Hcs) as Hc.
        assert (Hn1 : tele_rel (nparams_rel1 k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) nil nil) by (rewrite Hnp; split; reflexivity + exact I).
        eapply ind_rel_record; try eassumption.
        + apply (tele_rel_map _ (args_rel1 k nil c)); [| eassumption ].
          intros; eapply Ha; try eassumption; apply (tele_rel_nr_change _ _ HM); eassumption.
        + apply (IH Mk nil c gs nil nil nil HM);
            [ reflexivity | reflexivity | reflexivity | exact Hn1 | exact Hc | reflexivity | exact Har
            | rewrite Hnp; reflexivity ].
      - intros; constructor.
      - intros * Hia IH Mk ms c gsf gs1 vp vp' HM Hρ Hl Hl' Hn' Hc Heq Har HTs.
        constructor.
        apply (IH Mk ms c gsf (gs1 ++ ca_arg r A :: nil) (vp ++ v :: nil) (vp' ++ v' :: nil) HM);
          [ rewrite Hρ, nonrec_arg_vals_app, <- List.app_assoc by assumption; reflexivity
          | rewrite !List.length_app; cbn; lia | rewrite !List.length_app; cbn; lia | assumption | assumption
          | rewrite Heq, <- List.app_assoc; reflexivity | rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; exact Har
          | rewrite HTs; apply prefix_tele_snoc_arg ].
      - intros * Hsh IHs Hia IH Mk ms c gsf gs1 vp vp' HM Hρ Hl Hl' Hn' Hc Heq Har HTs.
        pose proof (nonrec_prefix_gen _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Heq Hl Hl' Har) as Hpre.
        constructor.
        + apply (IHs Mk ms c gs1 t gs (nonrec_arg_vals gs1 vp) (nonrec_arg_vals gs1 vp') 0 nil nil HM);
            [ rewrite List.app_nil_r; exact Hρ | exact Hn' | rewrite <- Heq; exact Hc | exact Hpre | reflexivity | lia
            | apply tele_prefix_rel_nil | rewrite HTs; apply prefix_tele_shape_start ].
        + apply (IH Mk ms c gsf (gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: nil) (vp ++ v :: nil) (vp' ++ v' :: nil) HM);
            [ rewrite Hρ, nonrec_arg_vals_app by assumption; cbn; rewrite List.app_nil_r; reflexivity
            | rewrite !List.length_app; cbn; lia | rewrite !List.length_app; cbn; lia | assumption | assumption
            | rewrite Heq, <- List.app_assoc; reflexivity | rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; exact Har
            | rewrite HTs; apply prefix_tele_snoc_rec ].
      - intros * Hb Hb' O O' Hr IHr; intros; econstructor; [ exact Hb | exact Hb' | exact (HK _ _ _ _ _ O) | exact (HK _ _ _ _ _ O') | exact IHr ].
      - intros * Hf IH Hfr Hfr' Mk ns c gs1 t0 gs2 ws ws' k0 ys ys' HM Hρ Hn' Hc Hw Hs Hk Hy HTs.
        subst Ts.
        destruct (ptyp_skip_pi _ _ _ _ Hs) as [HB Hs'].
        assert (Hkl : k0 < List.length (ptyp_doms t0)) by (apply List.nth_error_Some; congruence).
        pose proof (tele_rel_nr_change _ _ HM _ _ Hn') as Hn2.
        assert (Hk1 : List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1) <= List.length (cargs_nonrec (gs1 ++ ca_rec t0 :: gs2)))
          by (rewrite cargs_nonrec_app, List.length_app; lia).
        pose proof (tele_prefix_rel_ar_change _ _ HM _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hn' Hn2 Hc Hk1 Hw) as Hw2.
        pose proof (tele_prefix_rel_sh_change _ _ HM _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hn' Hn2 Hc eq_refl Hw Hw2 Hk Hy) as Hy2.
        pose proof (Hd _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HM Hn' Hn2 Hc eq_refl Hw Hw2 Hkl Hy Hy2) as Hdd.
        unfold shape_doms_rel in Hdd; rewrite (List.nth_error_nth _ _ _ HB) in Hdd.
        constructor; [| exact Hfr | exact Hfr' ]; intros a a' Haa.
        subst pre; pose proof (proj2 (Hdd _ _) Haa) as Haa1.
        apply (IH a a' Haa1 Mk ns c gs1 t0 gs2 ws ws' (S k0) (ys ++ a :: nil) (ys' ++ a' :: nil) HM);
          [ rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; reflexivity | exact Hn' | exact Hc | exact Hw | exact Hs' | lia
          | | apply prefix_tele_snoc_dom; exact HB ].
        apply tele_prefix_rel_snoc; [ exact Hy |]; unfold shape_doms_rel; rewrite (List.nth_error_nth _ _ _ HB); exact Haa1.
      - intros * Ef Ef' Hsh IH; intros; econstructor; [ exact Ef | exact Ef' | eapply IH; eassumption ].
    Qed.
  End FamChange.

The Elements of a Record Type

Two elements are related when their projections are related as a telescope at the fields' relations (record_rel). The projections of a value are unique, so the lemmas of TelePER carry over.

  Lemma record_projs_functional : forall R v vs ws, record_projs R v vs -> record_projs R v ws -> vs = ws.
  Proof.
    unfold record_projs; intros R v vs ws H1; revert ws.
    induction H1 as [| fT r fl rs Hr Hrs IH]; intros ws H2; inversion H2 as [| ? r' ? rs' Hr' Hrs']; subst;
      [ reflexivity |].
    f_equal; [ exact (functional_eval_proj _ _ _ _ Hr Hr') | exact (IH _ Hrs') ].
  Qed.

  Lemma record_projs_length : forall R v vs, record_projs R v vs -> List.length vs = List.length (record_fields R).
  Proof. intros * H; symmetry; exact (List.Forall2_length H). Qed.

Across two families of field relations that agree along prefixes related at both.
  Lemma record_rel_change : forall R fr1 fr2 v v',
      (forall k pa pb, k < List.length (record_fields R) -> tele_prefix_rel fr1 k pa pb -> tele_prefix_rel fr2 k pa pb ->
         (fr1 k pa <~> fr2 k pa)) ->
      record_rel R fr1 v v' -> record_rel R fr2 v v'.
  Proof.
    intros * Heq [vs vs' Hl Hr Hrel]; econstructor; [ exact Hl | exact Hr |].
    eapply tele_rel_map; [| exact Hrel ].
    intros k pa pb x y Hk Hp1 Hp2 Hxy; exact (proj1 (Heq _ _ _ Hk Hp1 Hp2 _ _) Hxy).
  Qed.

fields_per and fields_inv at the positions below the number of fields, as TelePER takes them.
  Lemma fields_per_lt : forall R fr, fields_per R fr ->
      forall k vs vs', k < List.length (record_fields R) -> tele_prefix_rel fr k vs vs' -> PER (fr k vs).
  Proof.
    intros * HP * Hk Hp; destruct (nth_error_lt_some' _ _ Hk) as [[f T] HT]; exact (HP _ _ _ _ _ HT Hp).
  Qed.

  Lemma fields_inv_lt : forall R fr, fields_inv R fr ->
      forall k vs vs', k < List.length (record_fields R) -> tele_prefix_rel fr k vs vs' -> (fr k vs <~> fr k vs').
  Proof.
    intros * HI * Hk Hp; destruct (nth_error_lt_some' _ _ Hk) as [[f T] HT]; exact (HI _ _ _ _ _ HT Hp).
  Qed.

  Section RecordPER.
    Variable (R : record_decl) (fr : nat -> list domain -> relation domain).
    Hypothesis (HP : fields_per R fr) (HI : fields_inv R fr).

    Let HP' := fields_per_lt R fr HP.
    Let HI' := fields_inv_lt R fr HI.

Related prefixes of the fields, swapped, composed, and on the diagonal.
    Lemma fields_prefix_sym : forall k a b, k <= List.length (record_fields R) ->
        tele_prefix_rel fr k a b -> tele_prefix_rel fr k b a.
    Proof. exact (tele_prefix_rel_sym _ fr HP' HI'). Qed.

    Lemma fields_prefix_trans : forall k a b c, k <= List.length (record_fields R) ->
        tele_prefix_rel fr k a b -> tele_prefix_rel fr k b c -> tele_prefix_rel fr k a c.
    Proof. exact (tele_prefix_rel_trans _ fr HP' HI'). Qed.

    Lemma fields_prefix_refl_l : forall k a b, k <= List.length (record_fields R) ->
        tele_prefix_rel fr k a b -> tele_prefix_rel fr k a a.
    Proof. exact (tele_prefix_rel_refl_l _ fr HP' HI'). Qed.

    Lemma fields_prefix_refl_r : forall k a b, k <= List.length (record_fields R) ->
        tele_prefix_rel fr k a b -> tele_prefix_rel fr k b b.
    Proof. exact (tele_prefix_rel_refl_r _ fr HP' HI'). Qed.

    Lemma record_rel_sym : forall v v', record_rel R fr v v' -> record_rel R fr v' v.
    Proof.
      intros * [vs vs' Hl Hr Hrel]; econstructor; [ exact Hr | exact Hl |].
      exact (tele_rel_sym _ fr HP' HI' _ _ _ (le_n _) Hrel).
    Qed.

    Lemma record_rel_trans : forall v v' v'', record_rel R fr v v' -> record_rel R fr v' v'' -> record_rel R fr v v''.
    Proof.
      intros * [vs vs' Hl Hr Hrel] [ws ws' Hl' Hr' Hrel'].
      pose proof (record_projs_functional _ _ _ _ Hr Hl') as <-.
      econstructor; [ exact Hl | exact Hr' |].
      exact (tele_rel_trans _ fr HP' HI' _ _ _ _ (le_n _) Hrel Hrel').
    Qed.

    Lemma record_rel_PER : PER (record_rel R fr).
    Proof. split; [ exact record_rel_sym | exact record_rel_trans ]. Qed.
  End RecordPER.
End Tele.
